title: Olympia, from the window
logline: The bus's window somewhere near Olympia: a capitol dome small in rain past a wet field, the seat's reflection empty. He never saw it; he draws the dome from the sound of the word.

panels.composition: A bus window in rain from inside: a wet green field and beyond it, small, a domed capitol building in gray, the glass reflecting an empty seat's headrest. The route north.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus window from inside in rain showing a wet green field and a small gray domed capitol building beyond, the glass reflecting an empty seat's headrest, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The dome from the sound of the word.
